Steve Silberman

United States · 1957–2024 · the journalist who rewrote the history of autism and named the neurodiversity movement
NeuroTribes · the recovered legacy of Hans Asperger · autism as natural human variation
Steve Silberman was the American science journalist whose 2015 book NeuroTribes rewrote the entire history of how the world thinks about autism. He had set out to write a magazine piece about why autism rates were rising, and he came back, several years later, with a book that argued the rates had not really risen at all. Autistic people had always been here. The world had simply, for most of the twentieth century, refused to see them properly. Silberman traced the reasons, and the reasons were ugly enough that the book reads, in places, like a quiet act of restitution.
